# XenonStack

> XenonStack is an AI Reasoning Foundry enabling enterprises to build, deploy, and orchestrate intelligent agentic systems for autonomous business operations.

XenonStack provides a comprehensive platform for agentic AI adoption across enterprise workflows. The company offers both flagship products (Akira AI, ElixirData, NexaStack, MetaSecure) and domain-specific AI agents for finance, operations, security, analytics, and supply chain automation, with integrations across major enterprise platforms like Snowflake, Databricks, ServiceNow, SAP, and Oracle.

## Key Topics

- Agentic AI Platform
- Multi-Agent Systems
- Enterprise AI Adoption
- AI Governance
- Autonomous Operations
- Akira AI
- ElixirData
- NexaStack
- MetaSecure
- Cloud Infrastructure
- Enterprise Solutions
- AI Agents
- Workflow Automation
- Compound AI
- Autonomous SOC

## Flagship Products

- [Akira AI - Agentic Orchestration](https://www.xenonstack.com/agentic-platforms/akira-ai): Multi-agent orchestration platform enabling workflow automation and intelligent task coordination
- [ElixirData - Agentic Analytics Platform](https://www.xenonstack.com/agentic-platforms/elixirdata): Real-time analytics and explainable insights powered by agentic AI
- [NexaStack - Inference AI Infrastructure](https://www.xenonstack.com/agentic-platforms/nexastack-unified-inference): Compound AI infrastructure optimizing model inference and deployment at scale
- [MetaSecure - AI-Driven Security](https://www.xenonstack.com/agentic-platforms/metasecure): Autonomous SOC operations and AI-powered security automation for enterprise defense
- [Neural AI - Design Studio](https://www.xenonstack.com/agentic-platforms/neural-ai): Business use case discovery and AI integration design studio

## Agentic AI Agents by Domain

- [Finance AI Agents](https://www.xenonstack.com/ai-agents/agentic-finance): Automate financial processes, compliance, and operational optimization
- [Agentic Operations](https://www.xenonstack.com/ai-agents/agentic-operations): IT, security, and service workflow automation for enterprise systems
- [Risk & Compliance AI Agents](https://www.xenonstack.com/ai-agents/agentic-risk-compliance): Auditing automation and security enhancement for regulatory compliance
- [Analyst Agent](https://www.xenonstack.com/ai-agents/agentic-analytics): Automate data insights and enable real-time data-driven decision-making
- [Supply Chain AI Agent](https://www.xenonstack.com/ai-agents/agentic-procurement): Procurement automation and logistics optimization for supply chain operations
- [Agentic Security Operations](https://www.xenonstack.com/ai-agents/agentic-security): Unified IT, security, and business team automation for autonomous operations

## Enterprise Platform Integrations

- [Snowflake AI Agents](https://www.xenonstack.com/ai-agents/snowflake-ai-agents): Automated data analytics and insights integration with Snowflake
- [Databricks AI Agents](https://www.xenonstack.com/ai-agents/databricks-ai-agents): Enterprise automation and scalable innovation on Databricks platform
- [ServiceNow AI Agents](https://www.xenonstack.com/ai-agents/servicenow-ai-agents): Intelligent workflow automation for IT, HR, and customer service
- [Jira AI Agents](https://www.xenonstack.com/ai-agents/jira-agents-actions): Support ticket automation and workflow enhancement for development teams
- [SAP AI Agent Ecosystem](https://www.xenonstack.com/ai-agents/sap-agents-actions): Business workflow and ERP process automation for SAP environments
- [Oracle AI Agents](https://www.xenonstack.com/ai-agents/oracle-agents-actions): Business transformation and productivity automation for Oracle systems
